values: RDW daily. Cutoff: November 3, 2026 at 01:00 UTC. Same five observed closes scored in every completed trial.
Retrospective tuning, not held-out accuracy. All raw paths count, including malformed candles.
Four seeds per row: 443, 444, 445, 446. Every run uses 10 future bars. CPU seconds sum work across CPU threads.
48 candles, T 0.6, top-p 0.75: no malformed candles in the four-seed confirmation. Mini remains the practical choice here.
40 and 64 candles offered slightly lower close error, but some malformed paths remained. More paths did not consistently improve fit.
Top-k 1 removed flags by making all 16 paths identical. It is not a useful uncertainty fan.
Parameters were selected after seeing the same five actual bars. Later dates and other tickers have not validated these settings.
A sampled min/max range is not a calibrated confidence interval. A valid candle does not establish a correct direction or trade.
Historical IEX archives may include later corrections. This test is not proof of point-in-time data availability.
Real pinned Kronos models ran on CPU with four Torch threads. These were coding-worker experiments, not a saved Card conversation.
Wall times exclude weight loading in the controlled sweeps. They reflect this laptop and host load, not cloud cost or GPU benchmarks.
The Trials table retains contended and anomalous timings. Compute charts use the final Mini sweep without a concurrent build.
A cold-load RNG bug was reproduced and fixed: load the model before setting the sampling seed. Cold and warm raw outputs then matched.
The controlled sweeps preloaded models, so their results are unaffected. No price clamping or invalid-path removal was used.
Small: 400 input candles, T 1.3, 16 paths, 10 future bars. Interrupted under memory pressure; no result recorded.
Base: 128 input candles, T 1.0, 16 paths, 10 future bars. Interrupted after the preceding expensive invalid result.
Tables and native charts link to the recorded trials. Changing a recorded setting does not rerun Kronos; new experiments require the app.
158 controlled trials plus 5 app checks. One forward-only app run has no actuals yet; it is not included in fit comparisons.

values: Lower price error and malformed-candle rate are better. Charts show measured settings, not a universal optimum.
10 future bars throughout. 16 paths except the path-count charts. Seed 443 except the four-seed comparison.
Helper tables below link to exact Trials rows. Repeated identical configurations remain separate runs in the log.
The cost scatter and path-count runtime chart exclude the contended model/window sweep and the elapsed-time anomaly.
Controlled trials share one RDW cutoff and input pool. The separately labeled app-ui-forward run uses a later cutoff and has no fit score.
Close/high/low errors use all five realized timestamps, even when the predicted OHLC candle is invalid. Blank = metric not captured.
400 completed RDW IEX daily candles. Every lookback ends November 2, 2026. Target dates start November 3.
Observed target candles (never supplied as forecast input)
OHLC validity: finite values, 0 < low <= min(open,close) <= max(open,close) <= high; volume >= 0.
Means include every draw. A path is flagged if any of its future candles fails that unchanged rule.
Top-k > 0 replaces top-p filtering. Top-k 1 is greedy. Amount is estimated from OHLC mean times volume.
MAE is mean absolute error in dollars. Range coverage counts actual closes inside the raw sampled min/max, not predicted daily high/low.
One elapsed-time outlier (28,468.685 s) is retained as Clock anomaly and omitted from compute charts.
App check runtimes include data fetching and any model loading; runtime thread settings differ from the four-thread experiment.
